subject: french
title: Comparing Cultures
welcome_lead: Comparing French-speaking cultures sharpens insight. Quebec vs France, Senegal vs Belgium — each comparison illuminates.
meta_desc: French: cultural comparison across the francophone world.

walkthroughs.body_html: Both speak French but diverge on secularism, food, music. Quebec is more North American in lifestyle, more European in language.
Senegal: French is official, Wolof widely spoken. Leopold Senghor was president and Negritude poet — politics and literature intertwined.
For Paper 2 / oral, structure: present each culture, find common ground, identify difference, reflect on what comparison reveals.
